pagedata.pyLabelOld: Deletes all the assignments for the specified WorkObject
pagedata.pyLabel: Deletes all the assignments for the specified WorkObject
pagedata.pyUsage: This activity can be called standalone or from a flow utility shape. If UpdateHistory is set to true it will add a History entry about the Deletion of assignment.
pagedata.pyDescription: Deletes all the Assignments for the specified WorkObjectID. Also updates the history with the value of 'AuditNote' param if 'UpdateHistory' param is set to true.

rowdata.pyStepsDescription: Check if WorkObjectID or key on primary page exists
Check if the PrimaryPage has the same WorkObject ID
Copy the PrimaryPage to WorkPage to proceed further
Check if the page exists on the clipboard
Open the WorkPage if not passed
Show error message if open failed
Call API activity to delete assignment
If PrimayPage was used Copy from WorkPage to PrimaryPage
If clipboard page is used copy it back to clipboardpage
Add history if set to true
Copy the error messages if there are any
